gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
I stand ___ my decision — it was the right one.
gaps.explanation: stand by something = continue to support it; stand by somebody = help and support them.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.

gaps.explanation: run out OF something = have none left.

gaps.sentence: Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
The doctors pulled him ___ after a difficult night.
gaps.explanation: pull through = recover from a serious illness.

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.
